text: Code reviews are an essential part of modern software development. When developers review each other's code before it is merged, they can catch bugs early, which saves time and money later. Code reviews also encourage knowledge sharing, because team members learn from each other's approaches and mistakes. In addition, regular reviews help maintain a high level of team quality, as everyone follows the same standards and good practices. Although code reviews take extra time, they are a valuable investment. In short, they make software more reliable and teams stronger.
